name: @js-temporal/polyfill
_note: Pinned for the #4628 Temporal runtime-object SPIKE, following the same acquisition rule as acorn (#1710) / clsx (#3748): a pinned npm-pack tarball committed as a fixture, NOT a vendored source copy and NOT an unpinned live fetch, so the harness reproduces from a clean checkout with no run-time network. shasum is the canonical npm sha1 (`npm view <pkg>@<ver> dist.shasum`); integrity is the canonical sha512. TWO tarballs are pinned because the polyfill's published ESM bundle is NOT self-contained: dist/index.esm.js carries exactly one import, `import e from"jsbi";`, against its single runtime dependency jsbi@^4.3.0. The harness links them into one module by concatenation (jsbi.mjs with its trailing `export default JSBI;` removed, then the polyfill bundle with the import statement rewritten to `const e=JSBI;`). That is safe by construction here, verified by parsing both bundles: jsbi.mjs declares exactly ONE top-level binding (`JSBI`) and the polyfill's 340 top-level bindings do not include it, so the concatenation introduces no shadowing. The link is the ONLY edit made to published bytes. dist/index.umd.js is measured as a second, link-free lane: it is self-contained (jsbi bundled in) but Babel-transpiled to ES5, so it exercises a different compiler surface than the modern ESM bundle. To refresh: `npm pack @js-temporal/polyfill@<ver> jsbi@<ver>`, update this file, re-run the harness.
